Title: GDD Spec: Pixel Noir Core Pillars
Content: Design pillars reference: 1. Investigation over combat. 2. Every Clue Is True. 3. High-stakes manual deduction. 4. Replayability through procedural logic.

Title: Engine: Master Time Budget & Clock
Content: Implement 72-hour case deadline counter. Action actions cost fixed time: District travel (15m), Object Search (30m), Interview (30m), Interrogation (60m).

Title: Engine: Universal Rest/Wait Mechanic
Content: Create UI action to rest in 15-minute increments anywhere in the world to advance time and meet NPC schedule windows.

Title: Engine: Detective Reputation Tracking
Content: Track global reputation. Degrade reputation on case timeout or lost interrogation. Reputation alters NPC narrative responses and baseline composure.

Title: Engine: Activity-Based Perk Triggers
Content: Implement event triggers for skill usage counts (searches, interviews). Automatically award perks (e.g., Forensic Efficiency) when thresholds are hit.

Title: Combat: Interrogation Turn Machine
Content: Build turn-based state machine tracking Suspect Resolve (Enemy HP) and Detective Composure (Player HP).

Title: Combat: Suspect Psychological Stances
Content: Implement Guarded (50% Press resistance), Rattled (2x Press damage), and Cornered stance modifiers.

Title: Combat: Coffee Inventory & Consumption
Content: Implement inventory item usage in combat restoring Composure: Instant Coffee (+20%), Drip Coffee (+50%), Double Espresso (+100%).

Title: Combat: Lockout & 24h Retry Cooldown
Content: When player Composure hits 0 or player concedes, apply a 24-hour interaction cooldown on the NPC and degrade player reputation.

Title: UI: Pokémon-Style Interrogation HUD
Content: Render suspect sprite/resolve bar, detective composure bar, status badges, and 4-slot menu (Tactics, Present Evidence, Coffee, Concede).

Title: UI: Integrated Clue Journal Overlay
Content: Build horizontal slide-in overlay during interrogation for selecting evidence. Differentiate World Facts [!] and NPC Claims [?].

Title: UI: Interactive Logic Grid Matrix
Content: Render dynamic workspace grid for facts. Support manual tagging of Direct Affirmation [✓] and Direct Negation [x].

Title: Content: MVP Town Map & 10 NPC Schedules
Content: Create small town district layout with pathfinding nodes and 24-hour routine schedules for 8–12 NPCs.

Title: Content: Case 01 Handcrafted Logic Tree
Content: Draft 1 complete mystery case containing physical evidence, suspect lies, alibis, and single deterministic solution path.
